test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 06 Dec 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Rearrange the parts of the sentence in correct order. **

One element that

P. is timing, in particular ensuring that

Q. is essential to navigating deep space

R. the time on board spacecraft is synchronised

S. with the time on the ground
solution:
The correct answer is option 4) i.e. "QPRS." 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the abovementioned paragraph, there is a chronological sequence of the sentences.
 
• Sentence Q is the first sentence as the paragraph begins with the subject **'One element that'** and therefore we have to use the verb **'is'** after it. The next part of the sentence is** "to navigating deep space," **which is a prepositional phrase that modifies the verb **"is essential."** This sets up the idea that the sentence is going to describe something that is crucial for navigating deep space.
 
• Sentence P is the second sentence as it begins with the helping verb **'is'** and explains what the essential element is. The essential element is timing. Thus it establishes a relation with the previous sentence.
 
• The only option that shows such an arrangement is **Option 4.**
 
• Sentence R is the third sentence as it begins with the noun 'the time' and mentions synchronizing the time on board spacecraft.
 
• Sentence S is the last sentence as it begins with the preposition 'with.' It tells us that it is important to ensure that the time on board the spacecraft is synchronized with the time on the ground thus it establishes a relation with the previous sentence.
 
• Thus, the correct answer is Option 4.

 

The correct order is:__

One element that

Q. is essential to navigating deep space

P. is timing, in particular ensuring that

R. the time on board spacecraft is synchronised

S. with the time on the ground
